fix_commit_message:
fftools/ffmpeg_dec: deep-copy subtitle_header to fix use-after-free

Found-by: Zhen Yan
Signed-off-by: Michael Niedermayer <michael@niedermayer.cc>
agent_reasoning: The bug-introducing commit added Decoder.subtitle_header as a shallow pointer copy of AVCodecContext->subtitle_header, creating a use-after-free once the AVCodecContext is closed/freed while the Decoder (and any consumer of dec.subtitle_header) may outlive it. The fix deep-copies the buffer into memory owned by the Decoder, changes the field to a non-const uint8_t* to reflect ownership, and frees it in dec_free(). I applied these exact changes to fftools/ffmpeg.h and fftools/ffmpeg_dec.c, matching the intro-commit's variable names (ist->dec_ctx rather than dp->dec_ctx, since that refactor hadn't landed yet in this snapshot) while preserving the same semantics as the upstream fix.
